description: This file defines the interface DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder, with nested interfaces for creating responses and events related to DeleteFeatures commands in a live signals processing context within the Eclipse Ditto framework.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturesLiveCommandAnswerBuilder
classes.description: Interface for building responses and events for DeleteFeatures commands, extending the ModifyCommandResponseStep.

classes.name: ResponseFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating command responses such as success or error responses for DeleteFeatures commands.

classes.name: EventFactory
classes.description: Factory interface for creating event types triggered by DeleteFeatures commands, specifically FeaturesDeleted.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a DeleteFeaturesResponse indicating successful deletion of features.

methods.name: featuresNotAccessibleError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating features were not accessible.

methods.name: featuresNotModifiableError
methods.description: Creates a ThingErrorResponse indicating features were not modifiable.

methods.name: deleted
methods.description: Creates a FeaturesDeleted event representing features deletion.
